purpose: Independent practice of C2.2 (find missing number in subtraction).
student_learning_goal: I can find the missing number in a subtraction equation.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can find the missing number in a subtraction equation.
header.character_watermark: Detective Dee in the top-right corner. Small (~1.5in tall).

parts.student_instructions: Find the missing number. The variable is what's REMOVED.
parts.visual_layout: Top of page. Six equation rows where the unknown is removed.

image_placeholders.description: Six equation rows in B&W line-art, ~7in x 3in. Pre-printed equations: 14 - ☐ = 6, 20 - ? = 12, 25 - ☐ = 10, 30 - ? = 18, 40 - ☐ = 25, 50 - ? = 35. Header 'Subtraction to 50:'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS03_P1_MS: keywords (subtraction, removed) name what the rows ask for.

parts.student_instructions: Find the missing number. The variable is the STARTING number — use the addition trick.
parts.visual_layout: Middle of page. Six equation rows where the unknown is the start.

image_placeholders.description: Six equation rows in B&W line-art, ~7in x 3in. Pre-printed equations: ☐ - 5 = 25, ? - 10 = 50, ☐ - 15 = 60, ? - 20 = 70, ☐ - 25 = 50, ? - 30 = 65. Header 'Subtraction to 100:'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS03_P2_MM: keywords (starting) name what the rows ask for.

parts.student_instructions: Write your own subtraction missing-number case. Pick where the variable goes. Solve.
parts.visual_layout: Bottom of page. A blank case box.

image_placeholders.description: A blank case-and-equation box in B&W line-art, ~7in x 2.5in. Top: case description lines. Middle: 'Equation: ___ - ___ = ___'. Bottom: 'Answer: ___'. Header 'My Case:'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS03_P3_OWN: keywords (case) name what the box asks for.

parts.answer_key: Open. Case must be a missing-number subtraction with a verified solution.

early_finisher_prompt: If you finish, swap with a partner and solve their case.
teacher_notes: Lesson 3 worksheet practices C2.2 subtraction. Watch for position confusion — children who treat all subtraction the same.
